summary: Melee Survival 7/10/34 with a one-hand axe, a dagger and a cat: Predator's Edge, Expose Prey into Mongoose Bite, Strider Kick and Lacerating Strikes. Forever's melee hunter build.
rotation: Pre-pull: walk into melee at -6s, Aspect of the Beast at -3s
Racials, potions and other cooldowns on cooldown
Hunter's Mark (rank 4, +140 ranged attack power) 1.5s before the pull and again in its last 3s; the raid's mark is off
Mongoose Bite whenever Expose Prey (or a dodge) opens it
Raptor Strike queued on the next swing when ready
Wing Clip in free GCDs (mana >= 50%), held when Mongoose Bite or Strider Kick is about ready
consumes: Dense Sharpening Stone (main hand and off hand)
caveats: Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets: 32 Agility and 14 crit rating, and an on-use 335 attack power for 20s every 2 min (at the pull, then on cooldown).
Pet scaling: 10% of RAP plus the hunter's hit (SoD placeholder for hit). With SoD's full 22% pet scaling this build would gain 18.
Wildstalker Armor 4-piece and 5-piece aren't in the preset (2-piece only). They would add nothing.
Assumed: Raptor Strike rank 8 adds 96, halfway between the client's 70 and Era's 0.88. Lower ranks keep the client's values.
Left out: Fire-toasted Bun (+9, seasonal) and Elemental Sharpening Stone (plans only from Molten Core).
Assumed: 22% more crit per Agility than Classic, the beta's level 1 ratio carried to 60.
Assumed: a pet's hit scales with its attack speed as in Classic. On the beta every pet hits like a 2.0s pet. The cat is still the best pet, and every cat speed sims within 1 DPS.
Keeps Rhok'delar's 2.9s bow. Survival never shoots, so every ranged weapon sims the same.

Hunter's Mark duty: the raid's Hunter's Mark is off and the hunter keeps its own up. The first cast is 1.5s before the pull, then one GCD and 60 mana every 2 min. Costs 1.1 / 1.3 / 1.1 DPS at 120s / 180s / 300s against Survival.
Human is best (Ruthless, 2% crit with any weapon since client 70425): 0.8 ahead of Orc at 180s and 2.0 at 300s. Orc leads by 1.6 at 120s.

Immolation Trap adds 2% of ranged attack power a tick (+15.5 DPS at 180s). The 15 October dev notes say fire traps now scale with attack power, but the client has no coefficient. The assumption runs none, 2% (Wrath's value) and 4%.
The raid's Trueshot Aura (a raid aura since client 70425, from the raid's Marksmanship hunter) adds 1.0 at 180s. It works through the pet's 10% of ranged attack power, since Survival never shoots.
